class.name: OcgBreptoolsTrsfmodification
class.brief_description: Describes a modification that uses a gp_Trsf to change the geometry of a shape. All functions return true and transform the geometry of the shape.
class.description: ! Describes a modification that uses a gp_Trsf to ! change the geometry of a shape. All functions return ! true and transform the geometry of the shape.

method.name: Trsf
method.description: Provides access to the gp_Trsf associated with this modification. The transformation can be changed.

method.name: IsCopyMesh
method.description: Sets a flag to indicate the need to copy mesh.

method.name: NewPoint
method.description: Returns true if the vertex V has been modified. If the vertex has been modified: - P is the new geometry of the vertex, and - Tol is the new tolerance. If the vertex has not been modified this function returns false, and the values of P and Tol are not significant.

method.name: NewParameter
method.description: Returns true if the Vertex V has a new parameter on the edge E. If a new parameter exists: - P is the parameter, and - Tol is the new tolerance. If no new parameter exists, this function returns false, and the values of P and Tol are not significant.

method.name: Continuity
method.description: Returns the continuity of <NewE> between <NewF1> and <NewF2>.
